description:
Your daily SPF armor – one kit for total sun defense!☀️

🌤️ Fact: Prolonged exposure to ultraviolet (UV) radiation accelerates skin aging, leading to wrinkles, loss of elasticity, and pigmentation. 

Our carefully curated suncare kit gives you complete & broad spectrum protection:

1️⃣ Ultra Light Sunscreen SPF50+ PA++++

Your lightest sun protector that blends in just 3 seconds!

2️⃣ Body Sunscreen Spray with SPF 50 

Easy to apply & non-messy sunscreen spray! 

✅ Non-Comedogenic – Won’t Clog Pores 

✅ Sweat & Water Resistant

✅ Dermatologist Approved for Daily Use

Each tube contains 50 ml of everyday sun defense.

Ultra Light Sunscreen:

On cleansed and toned skin, apply a generous amount of sunscreen on the face and neck.

Body Sunscreen Spray:

Step 1: Shake the bottle and keep it 1-2 inches away from your body.

Step 2: Spray generously around your body and gently massage it in.

For best results, repeat every 2 hours.

faqs.question: Is this suitable for all skin types?
faqs.answer: This kit is suitable for all skin types. SunCat DE present in body sunscreen spray makes it safe even for sensitive skin. AcZero technology present in our ultra light sunscreen makes it completely safe even for active acne or acne-prone skin. But since every skin type is different, we recommend doing a patch test before incorporating it in your routine.

faqs.question: Will this leave a white cast?
faqs.answer: No, both our sunscreens blend and absorb in just 3 seconds, leaving no white cast.

faqs.question: Does it have fragrance?
faqs.answer: No, both our sunscreens are fragrance free.

faqs.question: Is it sweat/water resistant?
faqs.answer: Yes, it is clinically proven to have water & sweat resistance, upto 80 mins.
